facts.title: uncontrolled movement of SG-7000 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-7000 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-7000 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 23 July 2021 an incident occurred on SG-7000 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
